research_question: Does a dated, independently attributable public record exist showing actual production deployment or field operation relevant to CML-PDRE-001?
decision_affected: Whether R5 FIELD_DEPLOYED can be evaluated.
minimum_sufficient_evidence: ONE dated independently attributable production-deployment or field-operation record.
allowed_future_actions: Search narrowly for the specified evidence class.
Inspect primary or independently attributable sources.
prohibited_future_actions: Infer deployment from ecosystem membership, partnership, roadmap, reference design, demonstrator, or management narrative alone.

stop_conditions.condition: One qualifying production-deployment or field-operation record is found.
One authoritative source directly refutes the relevant deployment interpretation.
The predefined bounded search is exhausted without finding the required evidence class.

limitations: This specification authorizes only a future bounded execution.
It does not establish R5, deployment, commercial migration, or any technical result.
